scope: Read-only task A audit: strict evidence projection and Summary gating. No source changes, tests, DB, model or network calls.

minimal_removal_map.keep: Ordinary merge/context flow; normal model context and citation metadata. Do not delete general DocumentService.read_source_chunk API merely because this call site becomes unused; check other callers before cleanup.

minimal_removal_map.remove: Once runtime no longer supplies them, the optional final_evidence_projection/merge_input_adapter fields and branches can be removed to avoid retaining the special path. The default existing path is explicit: merge(state,...) at 110-111, filter_top_k(state) at 118-119, then into_chat_message at 123-124.
minimal_removal_map.keep: Call cancellation/deadline checks and normal stage progression. filter_top_k only sorts/caps by score and stable IDs; it has no summary type filter (backend/weknora_port/retrieval/filter_top_k.py:25-34).

minimal_removal_map.remove: No source projection code is here. Avoid changing the SearchNothing catch: it is the normal no-retrieval fallback, currently also reached if projection line 521 fabricates SearchNothing after deleting all projected rows.
minimal_removal_map.keep: Only actual SearchNothing should take the fallback branch; permission/database/provider errors should remain distinct.

native_path_and_scope.python: retrieval/merge.py:371-383 selects rerank results or score-sorted Search results, deduplicates/history-injects, validates scope (376), resolves parents (378), sequentially merges, adds FAQ/neighbors, and sets merge_results. context.py:108-127 consumes merge_results; only FAQ is special, all other result types including summary pass through as document contexts. service.py:317 and 333-335 preserves Evidence.from_result, finalized context, and stage IDs.
native_path_and_scope.scope_reads_to_preserve: runtime.py:136-171 LeasedKnowledgeRepository validates scope owner and leases normal retrieval methods; storage/knowledge.py:76-82 requires owner and KB scope; 90-119 queries tenant-scoped chunks/KB/documents with soft-delete checks and optional document_ids; 123-130 independently validates returned tenant/KB/document scope. retrieval/search.py:59-81 validate_targets and validate_results remain. retrieval/merge.py:222-260 resolve_parents and 329-369 expand_neighbors continue using repository-scoped chunk reads. Do not convert DB/permission exceptions to SearchNothing.
native_path_and_scope.extra_source_read: documents.py:707-743 read_source_chunk has independent principal/tenant/document/source_version/original-content checks used by _project_source_evidence (runtime.py:506). This is the extra proof projection’s exact source read; normal parent/neighbor retrieval does not need it. Keep this general API if separately used; remove only the final-projection dependency unless repository-wide caller scan justifies more.

summary_native_behavior.upstream_merge: Fixed upstream chat_pipeline/merge.go:55-96 selects rerank-or-search, dedups, injects history, resolves parents, groups/merges, populates FAQ, expands neighbors and final-dedups; there is no summary-specific exclusion. summary_native_behavior.python: runtime.py:479 and 537-540 are the two explicit summary/model-generated-summary gates. Remove those gates with their adapters; do not cast summary to text. Existing types retain chunk_type; current context treats non-FAQ as ordinary document context.

tests.minimal_new_offline_checks: A focused port-level pipeline test should show (1) summary Search/Rerank rows survive merge/filter_top_k into context without requiring source_version/read_source_chunk; (2) a real empty Search still follows SearchNothing fallback; (3) out-of-scope candidates and parent/neighbor reads remain rejected by validate_results/scoped repository. Do not mistake the listed legacy tests as coverage of the production path.
